title: God dwells in the holy — favor, grace, John 14 mansion
source_text: XXVII. Ita quoque Deus dicitur in hominibus sanctis & justis habitare, quoniam eos regit propitius, & favore suo prosequitur & gratia exornat, singularesque in iis operationes edit. Tum quia homines frequentant, imo si possunt inhabitant ea loca quae amant, ad designandum summum illum amorem quo Deus justos prosequitur, dicitur eis inhabitare. Juxta illud Christi, Joan. 14. Si quis diligit me, sermonem meum servabit, & Pater meus diliget eum, & ad eum veniemus, & mansionem apud eum faciemus.
pass_a_gloss: So also God is said to dwell in holy and just people, because He rules them propitiously, and pursues them with His favor and adorns them with grace, and works singular operations in them. Then because people frequent, nay if they can inhabit, those places they love, to designate that highest love with which God pursues the just, He is said to inhabit them. According to that of Christ, John 14. If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word, and My Father will love him, and We will come to him, and make Our mansion with him.
pass_b_english: In the holy: propitious rule, favor, grace, singular works.
Love-language: as people inhabit what they love, God inhabits the just.
John 14: We will come and make Our mansion with him.
